qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the M6 screw on the vacuum pump on cylinder head for all engine types?
What is the torque specification for M9 screws on microencapsulated vacuum pump components for M51/M41 engines?
Which engine types use M8 screws for vacuum pump mounting?
What component is referenced under section 11 66?
What is the torque specification for microencapsulated vacuum pump screws on M51/M41 engines?
How many different screw sizes are specified for vacuum pump mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: Three different screw sizes: M6, M8, and M9

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M6 and M8/M9 screws for vacuum pump components?
qa_pairs.answer: M6 screws require 10 Nm while M8 and M9 screws require 22 Nm, a difference of 12 Nm
